## My Cycle 1.3.1

- Restores the owner-approved My Cycle launcher artwork.
- Removes the redrawn VectorDrawable/adaptive launcher replacement introduced in 1.3.0.
- Packages the launcher from a raster derivative of the approved PNG without redesigning, tracing or vectorizing the artwork.
- Adds a CI integrity check for the launcher resource and retains built APKs for direct package verification.

No diary data, privacy behavior, permissions or application features are changed in this patch.
